text:
ben_support: FYI AureliaPay reporting 429s + intermittent auth failures on their Dedicated pool r-ded-4. Started ~10:05 UTC during a long-context workload (>16k tokens).
maria_sre: alerting — kvcache.evictions spiked on r-ded-4a/4b, fragmentation high. Autoscaler didn't add headroom right away.
lucas_runtime: can you paste the runtime tail from 4a? suspect slab reallocs + prefix churn. run `kubectl logs -n redwood runtime-r-ded-4a -c runtime --since=15m | grep -i evict`
ben_support: logs (snip):
```
[2026-03-17T10:05:21Z] kvcache: evict prefix=acct:AURELIAPAY sess_len=18000 mem_frag=0.73
[2026-03-17T10:05:21Z] kvcache: slab_realloc failed size=8192 err=ENOMEM
[2026-03-17T10:05:23Z] auth: token-verify latency=120ms err=429 upstream=cache-miss
[2026-03-17T10:05:45Z] autoscaler: scale_event delayed reason=calming_window
```
maria_sre: that slab_realloc + mem_frag ~0.7 matches noisy-neighbor cache-wear pattern. Large per-session prefixes are fragmenting slabs.
jessica_account: AureliaPay is on a committed Dedicated plan — they're getting retries and some billing anomalies from retries. We need a customer-facing mitigation and ETA.
lucas_runtime: immediate mitigations I can push:
- set route config max_context=8192 for their model
- disable tenant-prefetch for their tenant (tenant_prefetch=false)
- increase eviction_grace in shared pool to avoid immediate wholesale evictions
I'll prepare a small rollout.
ben_support: repro steps we used:
1) mint token for aureliapay test account
2) POST /v1/generate with ~18k token prompt repeatedly in a tight loop
3) after ~15–40s observe 429s and auth token-verify spikes in logs
(repro artifacts attached to the ticket)
deploybot: deploy started: runtime-config patch applied to route aureliapay by lucas_runtime at 2026-03-17T10:22:10Z — {"max_context":8192,"tenant_prefetch":false}
maria_sre: proposal: reduce autoscaler calming_window to 10s on r-ded-4 to let headroom appear faster while we stabilize. tagging @eng-ops for approval. This reduces 429 tail risk.
lucas_runtime: creating an eng-runtime issue with heap snapshots + reproducer: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-4821 — notes: slab realloc spikes on large prefix churn, suggest kernel-level slab compaction trigger and better allocation reuse for prefix objects.
jessica_account: sending a customer update: "We're aware of degraded performance for large-context calls on your dedicated pool. We've applied temporary limits and are actively tuning autoscale and cache policies. We'll follow up with a timeline." :white_check_mark:
maria_sre: follow-ups: schedule forced compaction in maintenance window, add 24h on-call watch for r-ded-4, and prioritize RINF-4821. assigning to lucas_runtime + eng-sre.
ben_support: tagging AureliaPay support thread and closing the loop on initial mitigation. Will monitor and escalate if 429s persist.
